statement.text: Let $f\in \mathbb{C}[z]$ be a monic polynomial of degree $n$, all of whose roots satisfy $\lvert z\rvert\leq 1$. Let $ E= \{ z : \lvert f(z)\rvert \leq 1\}. $ What is the shortest length of a path in $E$ joining $z=0$ to $\lvert z\rvert =1$?
